q: What are your shipping options?
a: We offer Standard (3-5 business days), Express (1-2 business days), and Same-Day delivery in select cities. You can choose your option at checkout.

q: How long does delivery take?
a: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days. Express orders arrive within 1-2 business days after dispatch.

q: How can I track my order?
a: Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking link by email and SMS. You can also track it anytime from the 'My Orders' section of your account.

q: What is your return policy?
a: You can return any unused item in its original packaging within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.

q: How do I return a product?
a: Go to 'My Orders', select the item, and click 'Start a Return'. Print the prepaid label and drop the package at any courier location.

q: Can I exchange an item instead of returning it?
a: Yes, exchanges are free within 30 days as long as the item is unused and in original packaging. Select 'Exchange' instead of 'Return' in My Orders.

q: What payment methods do you accept?
a: We accept all major credit and debit cards, PayPal, UPI, and net banking.

q: Is it safe to use my credit card on your site?
a: Yes, all payments are processed through PCI-DSS compliant, encrypted payment gateways, so your card details are never stored on our servers.

q: Do you offer cash on delivery?
a: Cash on delivery is available for orders under $200 in most locations. You'll see the option at checkout if it's available for your address.

q: How do I create an account?
a: Click 'Sign Up' at the top of the page and enter your email and a password, or sign up instantly with Google or Apple.

q: I forgot my password, what do I do?
a: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page and follow the link sent to your registered email to reset it.

q: How do I update my shipping address?
a: Go to Account Settings > Addresses to add, edit, or remove a saved delivery address.

q: What is the warranty on your products?
a: Most electronics come with a 1-year manufacturer warranty covering defects. Extended warranty plans are available at checkout.

q: How do I claim a warranty repair?
a: Contact support with your order number and a description of the issue; we'll arrange a free pickup, repair, or replacement under warranty.

q: Can I cancel my order?
a: Orders can be cancelled for free within 1 hour of placing them from the 'My Orders' page. After that, please request a return once it arrives.

q: Do you ship internationally?
a: Yes, we currently ship to over 40 countries. International shipping times and fees are shown at checkout based on your address.

q: How can I contact customer support?
a: You can chat with us right here, email support@techgadget.example, or call our helpline at 1-800-555-0199, available 9am-9pm daily.

q: Do you have a loyalty or rewards program?
a: Yes! Join TechGadget Rewards for free to earn points on every purchase, redeemable for discounts on future orders.

q: Are your products covered by insurance?
a: Accidental damage protection plans are available for purchase alongside eligible products at checkout.

q: How do I apply a discount or promo code?
a: Enter your promo code in the 'Discount Code' box on the checkout page before completing payment.
